shortDescription.text: Secret-keyed or secret-looking value defined inline

fullDescription.text: A secret-keyed or secret-looking value is defined inline in the effective Compose model. Use an external secret source. Values are never emitted.
A ${VAR:?} / ${VAR?} required interpolation is in the required-error state. ComposeLens does not fabricate a value.

shortDescription.text: Enabled service depends_on a profile-gated target

fullDescription.text: An enabled service depends_on a target gated behind an inactive profile. Compose does not document auto-enabling that dependency.

shortDescription.text: include: or extends target is absent

fullDescription.text: An include: or extends reference points at a missing file or service. Cycle and unsupported forms are not this check.
A container-environment variable is set by multiple sources and a lower-precedence source was overridden.
docker compose config would refuse this file: an unknown top-level key, a non-string name or version, an invalid interpolation format, an include: that is not a list, or an include or extends cycle.
